messages:
Mira Patel: quick idea — run a tiny PLG launch for the Sprout seed cohort. mix: one launch post, a short benchmark thread, a 30m webinar, and inbound routing that flags high-intent signups. goal = activation lift + cost per activated user. 2-week runway. thoughts?

Jon Chen: sounds good. can we define primary metric and control? suggest activation (first meaningful request) at 7 days. control = current onboarding flow. also need baseline for time-to-first-response and support load.

Sam Ortega: drafted three post variants: 1) short hook + GIF, 2) engineering benchmark thread with latency/cost numbers, 3) prompt-template tease with mini demo. cadence: post on Mon morning, reminder Wed, webinar Thu.

Priya Das: webinar outline: 20m demo (fast path + cost breakdown), 10m Q&A. CTA: claim starter credits + grab prompt templates. landing form should include role and expected throughput to route leads. keep copy tight.

Liam O'Neill: routing plan: form -> our inbound webhook -> tag in Intercom. rules: if expected throughput >= 50 reqs/min OR selects enterprise in role -> tag sprout-high and alert SDRs. otherwise nurture with email drip and prompt pack.

Mira Patel: sample launch post copy (can iterate):
```
Ship faster LLM features without building infra. Sprout gives predictable latency, cost controls, and starter templates to get you from 0->1. Join our quick demo Thu — 30m. Claim starter credits when you sign up.
Link: https://redwood.example/sprout
```

Sam Ortega: posting variant for benchmarks (thread): short TL;DR, then 3 bullets: latency, cost per token, and example pipeline. includes GIF of dashboard.

Jon Chen: measurement plan: cohort = new signups from campaign UTM, track activation within 7 days, track 1-week retention, and tickets created in first 3 days. run A/B on post variant.

Priya Das: landing form fields: email, role, company size, expected monthly tokens, interested in Dedicated/Private? -> helps routing. keep form to 4 fields max.

Liam O'Neill: ops-bot can create webhook and a filter. @ops-bot can you spin up the endpoint and a test payload?

ops-bot: webhook created at https://hooks.redwood.example/sprout-1713456789. sample payload: { user_email: test@acme.com, expected_qps: 10, role: engineer }

Mira Patel: perfect. owners: Sam = creative + posts, Priya = webinar + landing, Liam = routing + infra, Jon = analytics. timeline: draft assets by Tue EOD, webhook + landing by Wed noon, post Mon, webinar Thu.

Sam Ortega: will drop 3 copy options in #marketing-drafts by Tue morning.

Priya Das: registering webinar in the calendar now, sending invites to list. RSVP page link once landing is ready.

Jon Chen: I'll wire up dashboards (activation funnel + cost) and send a short playbook for reporting.

Mira Patel: agreed. small experiment, quick learn. :eyes: :rocket:
